gloss: to disband; to dissolve; to break up

definitions.gloss: to disband; to dissolve (an organization, parliament, group)
definitions.explanation: Used for the formal dissolution of organizations, political bodies, or companies.

definitions.gloss: to break up; to disperse (of a gathering)
definitions.explanation: Used when a group of people gathered for a meeting, event, or outing goes their separate ways.

examples.japanese: バンドは{去年|きょねん}{解散|かいさん}した。
examples.english: The band broke up last year.

examples.japanese: {首相|しゅしょう}は{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}を{解散|かいさん}した。
examples.english: The prime minister dissolved the House of Representatives.

examples.japanese: その{会社|かいしゃ}は{経営|けいえい}{不振|ふしん}で{解散|かいさん}することになった。
examples.english: The company was dissolved due to poor management.

examples.japanese: では、{今日|きょう}はここで{解散|かいさん}しましょう。
examples.english: Well then, let's call it a day here.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{三時|さんじ}に{解散|かいさん}した。
examples.english: The meeting broke up at three o'clock.

examples.japanese: {遠足|えんそく}の{帰|かえ}りは{駅前|えきまえ}で{解散|かいさん}することになっている。
examples.english: We're supposed to break up in front of the station on the way back from the field trip.

notes:
A versatile word used both for formal dissolution and casual dispersal. The noun form {解散|かいさん} is often used on its own as a command or announcement: {解散|かいさん}！(Dismissed!).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国会|こっかい}を{解散|かいさん}する: to dissolve parliament
- {現地|げんち}{解散|かいさん}: break up at the location (i.e., no group return)
- {自主|じしゅ}{解散|かいさん}: voluntary dissolution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {散会|さんかい}: adjournment (of a formal meeting)
- {別|わか}れる: to part ways (more personal)
- {解体|かいたい}する: to dismantle (physical structures or organizations)
